name: Seitai Kansatsu ~Shokushu Kairou no Yakata~
original_name: 性体姦殺 ～触手回廊の館～
source: Himeko, who woke up in an unfamiliar house, met a boy in a similar situation, Koichi, and decided to seek out the criminals who locked her in here. However, what awaited such two people was the atrocious trap set by the lord of the hall. Koichi scolds and crawls on Himeko who is about to be attacked by a nanimono, and will bear the bruise of death. "The boy's life is three hours later .... If you want to live and get out of here, look for the three hidden keys in this hall. ”Himeko believes in information that can be said to be the only clue, and starts searching the inside of the hall where nanimonos crawl. Is it salvation to be waiting for her? Or ...
translation:
姬子在一栋陌生的房子里醒来，遇见了同样被困在这里的少年浩一。两人决定找出把他们锁在此处的犯人。然而，等待他们的是这座宅邸主人布下的残酷陷阱。

当姬子即将遭到某种怪物袭击时，浩一斥责着爬到她身上，替她承受了致命的伤害。

“那孩子的生命只剩三个小时……如果想活着离开这里，就去找出宅邸中隐藏的三把钥匙。”

姬子相信这条几乎是唯一的线索，开始在怪物出没的宅邸中寻找钥匙。等待她的究竟是救赎，还是……？
